source_text: Design a compact desktop lifting box. The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform. The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg. The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing. The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture. Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
product_intent: A desktop-sized manual lifting device that raises and lowers an internal platform through external hand crank rotation while enclosing its mechanism and supporting a specified payload within given height range

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box.
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform.
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg.
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing.
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable.
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed.
